message: 大賢者におまかせ

name: Synn
message: 「Yaaawn...」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, i-is there something on my face?」
Why is it that whenever Nanaka stares right at me, I get all flustered.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You. You're hiding something from me, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? W-What could you possibly mean?」
A whole bunch of things come to mind.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't play dumb! There's no way a healthy, sound-sleeping guy like you would be sleep-deprived for almost a whole week!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, well, that's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey. Is something worrying you?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's not like that」
I can't tell her I'm doing special training with the Demon Lord. I definitely can't tell Nanaka.

name: Paqy
message: 「Sigh... You're such a dense woman, Soba」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「When a guy his age gets absorbed in something late at night that he can't tell a girl about... well, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What」

name: Paqy
message: 「You really are a kid if you don't get it」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't get it either, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmph. Just leave everything to yours truly, the Great Sage」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Synn! Don't tell me! Every single night, you've been watching dirty DVDs!」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't been watching them! How did you jump to that conclusion?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's just like Master Synn says. He's not watching them, he's using them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really? Huh, no way, gross! I can't believe it! Synn, doing something so lewd!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Whaaat?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But, w-well, I mean, Synn's at that age too, and even if he's not as bad as Eddie, it's natural he'd be interested, and having zero interest in that stuff would be kind of weird too...」

name: Synn
message: 「You say that, yet you're keeping your distance a bit!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's your imagination, your imagination. Besides...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you were an 'uho' guy with no interest in the opposite sex, that'd be a huge problem... You already look like a shota as it is... If rivals from that side started showing up too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Don't tell me you! You're not into that kind of thing, right!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I-I have no idea what you're talking about」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-At least, i-it's dirty stuff with women, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, wh-what do you mean by that!? More importantly, what are you even asking me, Nanaka!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sh-Shut up, perv Synn! Cooties!」

name: Synn
message: 「So cruel!」

name: Paqy
message: 「See, I managed to smooth things over pretty well, didn't I?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even for a made-up excuse, that was way too awful! First of all, we don't even have a machine to watch DVDs at my house!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What matters is the result, man」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the worst!」
Nanaka acted somehow distant all day long.
Sigh...

name: Synn
message: 「Trans-form! Hah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nice, nice. That's gotten way smoother, man」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so?」

name: Paqy
message: 「All that's left is how long you can hold it. For now, the goal is three minutes, man」

name: Synn
message: 「That's unfair, Paqy! Preparing a late-night snack just for yourself!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get the wrong idea. This is Lord Synn's late-night snack, man」

name: Paqy
message: 「It takes three minutes until these cup noodles are ready to eat, man」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So if I don't want to eat half-raw noodles, I'd better give it my all!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You got it, man」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, something smells good! It's food, isn't it!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sally-chan!」

name: Sally
message: 「Amazing, President! Your hair's a different color! So gorgeous!」

name: Synn
message: 「Crap! Th-this is, uh, well」
She's gonna find out I'm the Demon Lord!

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmph. Flat-chest. You don't understand a man's heart at all.」

name: Sally
message: 「A man's heart?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't get it either, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just leave everything to yours truly, the Great Sage.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got a bad feeling about this...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn here dyed his hair, see. In other words, he's a delinquent!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, a delinquent! I know what delinquents are! They're the guys who do the poop squat in front of convenience stores!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The more straight-laced a guy is, the more he yearns for that kind of antisocial stuff.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh! I get it! President wants to be a delinquent!」
Thank goodness the Demon Lord is so obscure... I think?

name: Paqy
message: 「Tell you what, if you keep quiet about it, you can have that ramen over there.」

name: Sally
message: 「My lips are sealed! Thanks for the food!」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom nom, slurp slurp. Haaah. Gulp, gulp, gulp. Thanks for the meal!」

name: Synn
message: 「So fast!」

name: Sally
message: 「Nanaka and the others would be sad if they found out President became a delinquent, so I won't tell 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah... I'm counting on you.」
Being a delinquent might actually be better than being the Demon Lord.
